::: {#fig-qq-chol}

```{r}
wcgs |>
  ggplot2::ggplot() +
  ggplot2::aes(sample = chol) +
  ggplot2::stat_qq() +
  ggplot2::stat_qq_line(color = "red") +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Standard Gaussian quantiles", y = "Cholesterol (mg/dL)")
```

Normal Q-Q plot for total cholesterol in the WCGS dataset

:::

In @fig-qq-chol, the points curve above the reference line at the right,
which matches the long right tail in @fig-hist-chol.
